requirements.title: STAT_LOCKED_OTHER_IMAGE has the specified status value semantics
requirements.definition: STAT_LOCKED_OTHER_IMAGE is a default integer scalar constant. It is assigned to an UNLOCK statement STAT variable for a lock variable locked by another image.
